name: FocoClipping
description_en:
FocoClipping is a product in the Photo editing category. Its directory profile covers Transform tools, Remove objects, Import from web, Enhancement Tools, Effects and Filters, Batch Editing, Auto Select, Social Media Integration.

Additional listed capabilities include Import-Export Option, Built-in Templates. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
